admission.justification: The pass enforces memory/concurrency/priority while the transport confines every load to the non-interrupting timeline operation; omitting either can over-admit or interrupt live agents.

applicability: Automatic tree-agent warmup on the admitted configured host process start.
conditions: A single OS lease and exact-start progress record own the pass across product servers.
Memory is checked before admission; unknown/below6GiB waits and eventually gives up with click-load reasons.
The host listing supplies unarchived candidates, and inflight loads retain their slot.
exclusions: No host restart, refresh_agent, message send or archived-agent resurrection.
No latency/processor-share promise follows from the feature witness.

evidence: MIK-R145@v1 rules2-5; native round5 passed freeze; mcp/tests/test_paseo_warmup_run.py and test_paseo_warmup_operations.py

statement: A host-start loading pass admits at most two timeline resumes, waits when available memory is unknown or below the threshold, promotes clicked pending agents, and never sends a message, interrupts a turn or refreshes an archived agent.
